correctness.rationale: The full 208-facet presentation reconstructs f=(13,78,286,715,1014,728,208) and therefore four-neighborliness. Exact mod-two ranks are rank(d3)=220 and rank(d4)=493, giving H3 dimension two. Every one of the 273 missing five-set boundaries is explicitly checked to be a 3-cycle and nonzero modulo im(d4); the quotient contains exactly three nonzero classes, each occurring 91 times. Present five-set boundaries reduce to zero. The first two class representatives are distinct nonzero elements, hence a basis, and the third is checked to be their sum.

value.rationale: The minimal triangulation has rank-two middle homology, so the shortest support layer naturally asks not only how many carriers exist but how they populate the three nonzero mod-two classes. The exact perfect balance 91,91,91 is a complete structural invariant of that layer and is especially notable because the complex has no nontrivial simplicial automorphism that could force class transitivity.
